metas.name: 1. Subterranean Homesick Blues
metas.description: Bean, Elfo and Luci become trapped in an underground world full of eerie little creatures — and Queen Dagmar. Zøg tries to thwart a plot against him.

metas.name: 2. You're the Bean
metas.description: As Zøg attempts to escape a harrowing situation, Derek discovers a book that implies his family is cursed. Bean hatches a plan to escape from Trøgtown.

metas.name: 3. Beanie Get Your Gun
metas.description: Zøg's acting strange, and Bean investigates to learn why. Meanwhile, a despondent Derek finds some surprising mentors in the Enchanted Forest.

metas.name: 4. Steamland Confidential
metas.description: After traveling to Steamland, Elfo enthralls the denizens of an upscale explorers' club while Bean infiltrates a factory in search of the Arch Druidess.

metas.name: 5. Freak Out!
metas.description: Bean flees when she discovers more about Alva's intentions — and as his lightbulb-headed robots chase her through Steamland, she searches for Elfo.

metas.name: 6. Last Splash
metas.description: On their return trip to Dreamland via steamboat, lovelorn Elfo winds up in an unusual relationship while Bean gets close to Mora the mermaid.

metas.name: 7. Bad Moon Rising
metas.description: Bean overhears Odval and the council plotting against Zøg, so she joins forces with Oona to undermine their plan while Elfo and Luci raise an army.

metas.name: 8. Hey, Pig Spender
metas.description: After trying to help Prince Merkimer lift the curse that turned him into a pig, Bean asks his parents for resources to thwart the threat from Steamland.

metas.name: 9. The Madness of King Zøg
metas.description: As a mysterious cloud of green smoke moves toward Dreamland and Zøg becomes more unstable than ever, Bean finds a unique way to communicate with him.

metas.name: 10. Bean Falls Down
metas.description: Bean's having a stressful day! First, an old nemesis arrives, acting suspiciously contrite. Then, vicious ogres invade and won't leave without Elfo.

metas.name: 11. Love Is Hell
metas.description: In hell, Bean resists Dagmar's attempts to force her to marry Satan. Meanwhile, Luci plots to flee heaven and Elfo tries to escape from the ogres.

metas.name: 12. The Good, The Bad, and the Bum-Bum
metas.description: Bean, Jerry and Luci commandeer an airship from Alva. Held captive by the ogres, Elfo discovers an entire family history he knew nothing about.

metas.name: 13. The Cabinet of Dr. Chazzzzz
metas.description: Zøg is institutionalized with Chazzzzz, while Vip and Vap launch an epic rescue. Bean doesn't get the warm reception she expects at Dreamland.

metas.name: 14. Goon Baby Goon
metas.description: Bean and her friends are reunited with Zøg and discover that Becky and Cloyd have seized Dreamland, secretly transforming its citizens into goons.

metas.name: 15. The Pitter-Patter of Little Feet
metas.description: After Sorcerio brings Freckles to life, the wooden puppet sets out to undermine Zøg with a comedy roast and an alliance with Becky and Cloyd

metas.name: 16. What to Expect When You're Expecting Parasites
metas.description: Zøg, Bean and her friends plunge into the ocean, where they find a submerged castle inhabited by Sea Trøgs guarding a treasure linked to the Elves.

metas.name: 17. The Unbearable Lightning of Bean
metas.description: Lonely Zøg searches the forest for his true love, Ursula the Bear, who's got a secret. Elfo, Luci and Bean stumble upon the site of an ancient battle.

metas.name: 18. Spy Vs. Spy Vs. Spy
metas.description: Ordered to spy on the elves, Elfo is captured and forced to spy on the Trøgs - who see through his disguise and return him to spy on the humans.

metas.name: 19. The Goo-Bye Girl
metas.description: Freckles manipulates Derek and Bear Boy into confronting some bullies. The secret of the goo is out but who will drink it to become the savior?

metas.name: 20. Bean Falls Apart
metas.description: In her dreams, Bean confronts her inner "Bad Bean" but the evil doppelgänger conceals a sinister plot. Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles get captured.
